github.evidence: Agent HQ 'mission control': assign, steer mid-session, monitor live session logs, track active sessions; Agents tab in a repo + the Agents page (github.com/copilot/agents); review and merge agent code by jumping to the pull request.

dimension: N isolated workspaces from one baseline

github.evidence: Multiple agent sessions run concurrently; each cloud agent session gets its own environment.
Per-pull-request diffs: every agent session lands as a PR whose Files changed view is the per-change diff against the base.
One-click merge-conflict resolution within a single PR only; no cross-change conflict map across concurrent agent changes was found this run.

dimension: N concurrent proposals as one comparable set

github.evidence: The human review/integration surface is one pull request at a time ('jump to the pull request to review'); no surface compares or integrates multiple independent agent-produced changes together.

dimension: Per-change intent record, durable across rebases

github.evidence: No GitHub surface ships a per-change intent record; the only announced provenance layer (Entire's Checkpoints) is a different vendor, announced-not-shipped for the platform.

dimension: Push-style event feed driving the UI

github.evidence: Push events drive the platform; live session logs stream in mission control.

dimension: Land a chosen change with validation evidence

github.evidence: Per-PR merge with one-click conflict resolution; agents' code is reviewed and merged via the pull request.

dimension: Secret-class files as typed objects, masked by default

github.evidence: No secret-class typing, masking, or audited reveal surface was found in the GitHub baseline this run.

dimension: Agent access policies managed like developers

github.evidence: Agent identity features: control which agent builds a task; manage agent access/policies 'just like any other developer'.

dimension: Typed advisory judgments over the set

github.evidence: No typed advisory/judgment surface over a set of concurrent changes was found in the GitHub baseline this run.

dimension: Inline per-line review comments on a change

github.evidence: Pull-request review with inline per-line comments is the core GitHub flow an agent PR enters.

dimension: Third-party agents hosted inside the platform

github.evidence: Third-party coding agents from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cognition and xAI run inside GitHub under the existing paid Copilot subscription; Google's Jules becomes a native assignee.
GitHub is a file/repo browser first — every repo serves a browsable tree, blame, and history natively.
GitHub Issues is the incumbent's native task tracker that agent sessions are assigned from.
GitHub Actions: branch controls over when CI runs on agent code.
Per-PR merge ordering is the native landing path; one-click merge after review.
No native stacked diffs on GitHub; stacked PRs are third-party (Graphite) on top.
